additional_requirements.title: Test signing of all artifacts on all releases
additional_requirements.text: Ensure every artifact in every release is signed.

additional_requirements.title: Test locking of all external dependencies used in the build process
additional_requirements.text: Ensure every external dependency being used in pipelines is locked.

additional_requirements.title: Test validation of dependencies before use
additional_requirements.text: For every dependency used in every pipeline, ensure it has been validated.

additional_requirements.title: Test creation of reproducible artifacts by the build pipeline
additional_requirements.text: Ensure that build pipelines create reproducible artifacts.

additional_requirements.title: Test production of a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) by pipeline steps
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, ensure it produces a Software Bill of Materials on every run.

additional_requirements.title: Test signing of the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) produced by pipeline steps
additional_requirements.text: For each pipeline, ensure it signs the Software Bill of Materials it produces on every run.

additional_requirements.title: Test signing of all artifacts on all releases (level 2)
additional_requirements.text: Ensure every artifact in every release is signed.
